title: Convert validation ranges to the adopted sign rule
status_note: Round 3. The run pelvis band is mirrored exactly in the two active profiles only, and D-CORE-07-1 stays withdrawn. At coordinator direction, the 20 docs/datasets/*_validation_ranges.yaml snapshots were restored byte-identical to commit 569ee8f; round 2 had flipped them on an instruction the coordinator later corrected. The flip is exact for sign; it does not establish the band's zero.
summary: Classified every feature in contributor_tools/validation_ranges (7 files) from range values in context; the verifier agreed with every classification. Joints, joint moments, joint velocities, thigh/shank/foot segment angles and velocities, vertical and fore-aft GRF, and fore-aft CoP agree with rule B. Frontal/transverse features and sideways GRF/CoP are outside rule B. pelvis_sagittal_angle_rad: the sit-to-stand and stand-to-sit entries already read as rule B (the pelvis tips forward mid-transfer and the centre goes negative), and the transition entries are near-symmetric magnitude checks; both are unchanged. The run entries (phases 0, 25, 50, 75) were a constant band [-0.05, +0.63..0.68] centred near +0.3 rad, which is anterior-positive under every documented zero; running tilts the pelvis forward, which is negative under rule B. These 4 entries were mirrored exactly (negated, min and max swapped, digit text preserved) in the two active profiles, default_ranges.yaml and gtech_2024_ranges.yaml. Each changed file gained a top-level sign_rule_conversions provenance note (date, CORE-07, rule B / D-UM21-C03-1, reason, and that the band's zero is undocumented). No other byte changed. The docs/datasets/*_validation_ranges.yaml snapshots are records of legacy validation runs under the old pelvis sign. They are left unchanged on purpose and are byte-identical to 569ee8f. Per the verifier, the walking and stair pelvis entries in the 11 snapshots from 2025-11-25 consistently read anterior-positive, so each snapshot is an internally consistent old-convention record.

inventory.method: Per feature, range bounds and midpoints were read per task and phase and compared with known sagittal biomechanics (e.g., swing knee flexion, seated hip/thigh flexion, push-off plantarflexor moment, stance knee extensor moment in decline, braking GRF, toes-down foot after toe-off, pelvis forward tilt during sit/stand transfers). Only YAML range files and converter source code were read; no research data.

gtech_2024_ranges.yaml.note: Pelvis, run and transition entries identical to default_ranges.yaml.

strokepig_ranges.yaml.note: Untracked file (not at HEAD). Bounds are close to symmetric about 0 (pelvis about -1.4 to +1.5 rad), so values are non-diagnostic. Its converter maps gait2392 pelvis_tilt (counterclockwise by model definition) and builds thigh = pelvis + hip. Left unchanged.

impaired_ranges.yaml.note: Hip/knee/ankle joint angles only (swing knee flexion positive, push-off ankle negative). Template without a 'tasks' mapping, so it is not a loadable profile (pre-existing).

example_custom_ranges.yaml.note: Template. Legacy or non-schema names: ankle_flexion_angle_ipsi_rad, *_Nm, grf_vertical_ipsi_N, trunk_flexion_angle_rad (forward lean positive, a named-direction column, not trunk_sagittal_angle_rad). Values agree with their names.

test_custom_phases.yaml.note: Phase-support demo; legacy ankle_flexion name, values dorsiflexion-positive.

validation_ranges_with_adduction.yaml.note: Legacy 2025 UMich-derived file, referenced by no code. *_Nm moments have per-kg magnitudes; hip extensor early stance, ankle plantarflexor at push-off and knee extensor in decline stance are negative (agree). Contains NaN bounds for incline_walking moments, so the profile loader rejects it (pre-existing at HEAD).

pelvis_evidence.reading: Both transfers tip the pelvis forward mid-movement; the midpoints go negative there, which is counterclockwise (rule B). Under anterior-positive they would describe the pelvis tipping backward while rising, which is not the known pattern.
pelvis_evidence.run: [-0.05, +0.63..0.68] at every phase: a constant offset with no within-cycle sign signature. Positive reads as anterior tilt only if the zero is upright standing; the source zero is not documented.
pelvis_evidence.provenance: The tuning dataset per task is not recorded in the file. Converters that output pelvis_sagittal_angle_rad for these tasks: AddBiomechanics (b3d pose index 0 = OpenSim pelvis_tilt, heading-dependent), GT21 (pelvis_tilt, mostly frontal obliquity per docs/quality/audits/gt21-c01-conventions.json), GT23 (pelvis_Z from local YZX Euler, 'anatomical_mapping_unassessed' per gt23-joint-sign-and-segment-evidence.json). None comes from the UMich clinical (anterior-positive) source; default_ranges has no walking-task pelvis ranges.
pelvis_evidence.older_snapshots: The 2025-11-25 per-dataset snapshots in docs/datasets (e.g., fr12) also carry walking-task pelvis ranges: incline midpoints positive and decline negative (reads anterior-positive), level near zero. The source is mixed across tasks.

inventory.outside_rule_b: Hip/knee/ankle adduction and rotation angles and moments and pelvis frontal/transverse: frontal and transverse signs are not yet adopted. grf_lateral_* and cop_lateral_*: the outward-per-leg rule is decision D-GT21-C01-1, not rule B; ipsi/contra ranges do not record which physical leg, so it is not assessed here.

mirrored_features.zero: Undocumented. The flip is exact for sign but does not establish the zero; a later range task should rebuild the band from rule-B reconverted data with a stated zero.

unchanged_by_design: docs/datasets/*_validation_ranges.yaml: legacy old-convention records, byte-identical to 569ee8f on purpose.
sit_to_stand, stand_to_sit and transition pelvis entries in the active profiles (already rule B, or near-symmetric).
strokepig_ranges.yaml (untracked; it has no run task, and its bounds are near-symmetric).
All other features in every range file.
